title: URDF IK
description: Drag a UR10e or UR5 tool or a Unitree G1 palm or sole. Inspect joint configurations and pose errors in the browser. Local mode adds the GTDynamics factor graph and more robots.

title: Contact Labels
description: World-frame sole motion provides contact labels for three SSIO G1 snippets. A discrete factor graph combines motion evidence with walking priors.

title: Contact Initialization
description: Shared sole-pose landmarks initialize three SSIO walking snippets from max-product support labels. Selectable priors expose their effects on the estimate.

title: Contact vs IK
description: Contact and inverse-kinematics initializers feed the same smoothing graph on three ten-second G1 snippets. Recorded iterations show how the starting point affects convergence.

title: Kinematics
description: Full-trajectory G1 smoothing combines contact landmarks with optional Gal3 IMU aiding and a return-to-start position prior. Recorded results include factor errors and foot slip.

title: Interpolation
description: Inspect floating-base GP interpolation of the best Kinematics trajectory, dense joint measurements, estimated velocities, and stance-foot motion.

title: Dynamics
description: CMC-Opt estimates ground reaction forces and joint torques from fixed G1 kinematics using one wrench per sole.

title: Kinodynamics
description: Inspect a coupled 50 Hz G1 trajectory solve initialized by contact poses, GP velocities and a linear dynamics seed.

title: Motion Planning
description: A kinematic factor graph optimizes a Franka arm trajectory between two hand poses. Playback shows the solver iterations and resulting joint motion.

title: SCATE UR5
description: Replay SCATE on a UR5: an obstacle discovered online is avoided by re-solving after every step, beside a blind run that hits it. Inspect the replanned paths, the obstacle estimate, and clearances.

title: SCATE UR10e
description: The SCATE UR5 scenario on a UR10e: the same planner, online loop and obstacle placement with the UR10e's geometry and collision spheres. Compare the replanned paths, obstacle estimate, and clearances with the UR5.

title: SCATE UR10e Base
description: Reactive SCATE on a UR10e among two moving obstacles tracked by a VICON-like system, with a cost on the base reaction wrench. Toggle the cost-off run and three cost weights to compare base torque and clearance.
